hero.title: Recognize and preserve our plants!

dampak.title: Positive Impact
dampak.desc: has carried out activities in line with its vision and mission across various regions in Indonesia, including field activities and the compilation of plant species data found in Indonesia.

botani.title: Botany for Everyone
botani.desc: aims to encourage Indonesian botany enthusiasts to actively contribute to the advancement of plant research and conservation.
botani.desc-2: Various initiatives have been carried out to enhance the capacity of local botanists beyond academic and research circles, enabling them to recognize and maximize their local potential.

card1.title: Research
card1.desc: Research is one of YTAN’s main objectives, with a primary focus on studying the diversity of flora in Indonesia.

card2.title: Conversation
card2.desc: Conservation serves as a means to preserve plant species in Indonesia, particularly those that are rare and endangered.

card3.title: Education
card3.desc: YTAN is committed to providing and widely disseminating information about the diversity of plant species in Indonesia.

contact.title: Have ideas, suggestions, or feedback for YTAN?
contact.desc: We’d love to hear your thoughts and grow together in preserving Indonesia’s plant diversity.

ed1.title: Instagram
ed1.desc: YTAN regularly shares a variety of information through its social media platforms, including interesting facts, infographics, statistics on Indonesian flora, and other relevant insights.

ed2.title: Botanical Education
ed2.desc: To support plant awareness and conservation efforts, the YTAN team regularly participates in various training programs, webinars, and other educational events.

ed3.title: Plants Community
ed3.desc: Indonesia has a growing community of flora enthusiasts. However, one of the main challenges in studying plants is the complexity of identification information. Therefore, YTAN actively contributes to facilitating plant identification discussions and forums through social media platforms.

sejarah.title: History of YTAN
sejarah.content1: The Indonesian Native Plants Foundation (Yayasan Tumbuhan Asli Nusantara – YTAN) is a non-governmental organization established in June 2023 with a primary focus on the conservation of Indonesia's native plant diversity and forest ecosystems.
sejarah.content2: The foundation originated from a small group of researchers and volunteers committed to documenting and disseminating fundamental data on Indonesia's native plant diversity through the voluntary initiative
sejarah.content3: YTAN was established to strengthen the sustainable management of forest resources and plant biodiversity through scientific research, conservation, ecological restoration, and environmental education.
sejarah.content4: Over the past three years, YTAN has collaborated with government agencies, private-sector partners, universities, and international institutions on a wide range of initiatives related to the study and conservation of Indonesia's native plant diversity.
sejarah.content5: Through these collaborative efforts, YTAN is committed to fostering partnerships at both the national and international levels to advance scientific knowledge, promote the conservation of native plant diversity, and support the long-term sustainability of Indonesia's botanical heritage for future generations.
